rounds.text: The valuation and operational health of Chemtech Industrial Valves Ltd present severe structural concerns, highlighted by a trailing twelve month compounded profit growth collapse of -65% [E21] and a net profit drop of -77% year-over-year [E63]. Operating margins have deteriorated drastically, crashing by 16 percentage points to 2% in the TTM period [E30] and plummeting 31 percentage points in the June 2026 quarter compared to the previous year [E31]. Furthermore, cash generation is deeply compromised, evidenced by a negative operating cash flow of Rs -10.46 Cr and a free cash flow of Rs -16.35 Cr for March 2026, leading to a dismal cash conversion ratio of -2.08x [E34, E35, E36]. Working capital pressures are intensifying as debtor days expand from 99.6 to 127 days and total working capital days surge from 169 to 267 days [E55, E57]. Compounding these operational red flags, promoter confidence is waning sharply, with insider ownership dropping by over 20 percentage points from 60.72% in December 2023 to 40.68% by September 2026 [E40]. conceded: [E44]
